title: Salsa Verde
description: Tomatillos, jalapeños, onion, and garlic charred until blistered, then blended with cilantro and lime. Tart, smoky, and made in fifteen minutes.
notes: Keeps five days in the fridge. Boiled rather than charred is the other classic — brighter and sharper.

steps.text: Roast the tomatillos, jalapeños, onion, and unpeeled garlic on a dry comal or under a hot grill, turning, until blistered and softened.
Squeeze the garlic from its skin and blend everything with the cilantro, lime juice, and salt to a chunky purée.
Taste and add a splash of water if it is too thick.
